newsitem.title: USA: US's Summers cautions on Japanese trade imbalance.
newsitem.headline: US's Summers cautions on Japanese trade imbalance.

text.p: Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers said Monday it would be unfortunate if Japan's trade surplus increases again.

"Too often in the past we have seen a cycle in which Japan's trade surplus has declined and then risen again, setting off protectionist pressures and trade frictions around the world," he told a reporters' lunch. "It would be unfortunate if Japan's surplus were again to become a major asymmetry in the world economy."
President Clinton meets Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto Friday, where the White House says he will discuss the need to boost Japanese domestic demand.
Analysts say increased consumption of domestic goods by the Japanese would help ease any danger of an imbalance in exports.
